Section 99D.9D, Code 2026, is amended to read as 1 follows: 2 99D.9D Alternative simulcasting licensure —— horse and dog 3 races. 4 1. An entity that has entered into an agreement with the 5 Iowa horsemen’s benevolent and protective association for 6 source market fees related to simultaneously telecast horse 7 or dog races may submit an application to the commission for 8 a license under this chapter to conduct pari-mutuel wagering 9 on simultaneously telecast horse or dog races, subject to 10 the requirements of this section . If an application for a license under subsection 1 is 16 approved by the commission pursuant to the requirements of 17 this section and section 99D.9 , the entity submitting the 18 application shall be granted a license under this section to 19 conduct pari-mutuel wagering on simultaneously telecast horse 20 or dog races conducted at a facility of a licensee authorized 21 to conduct gambling games under chapter 99D or chapter 99F 22 pursuant to an agreement with the licensee of that facility 23 as authorized by this section . A licensee issued a license 24 pursuant to this section shall comply with all requirements 25 of this chapter applicable to licensees unless otherwise 26 inconsistent with the provisions of this section . 27 3. Section 99D.15, subsection 4, paragraph b, Code 13 2026, is amended to read as follows: 14 b. If wagering on simultaneously telecast horse races and 15 dog races is conducted by a licensee under section 99D.9D , 16 a tax of two percent is imposed on the gross sum wagered by 17 the pari-mutuel method on horse races and dog races which 18 are simultaneously telecast in excess of twenty-five million 19 dollars in a calendar year. The tax revenue from simulcast 20 horse races under this paragraph shall be deposited in the Iowa 21 horse racing fund created in section 99D.27B . The remaining 22 amount of tax revenue shall be deposited with the commission. 23 Sec. 3. EFFECTIVE DATE. This Act takes effect July 1, 2027. 24 EXPLANATION 25 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 26 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 27 This bill removes the authority of the state racing and 28 gaming commission to issue licenses to conduct pari-mutuel 29 wagering on simultaneously telecast dog races to an entity 30 that has entered into an agreement with the Iowa horsemen’s 31 benevolent and protective association for source market fees. 32 The bill takes effect July 1, 2027. 33 The bill does not otherwise amend or eliminate 34 authorizations for or references in the Code to dog racing 35 -2- LSB 5651XC (3) 91 ss/ns 2/ 3 S.F. _____ generally or wagering on simultaneously telecast dog races 1 under other licenses. 2 -3- LSB 5651XC (3) 91 ss/ns 3/ 3
